question:
How many horizontal rows are present in the modern periodic table?

[SSC GD 2024]
options: 9
11
7
5
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 7

Explanation:
The modern periodic table has a total of 7 horizontal rows, known as 'periods'. Each period represents a new energy level. The first period contains the least number of elements (2 elements), while the sixth and seventh periods contain more elements. This classification of the periodic table was proposed by Henry Moseley, where elements are arranged based on their atomic number.

Extra Facts:
☛ The periodic table has 18 vertical columns, called 'groups'.

☛ Lanthanides and Actinides are placed separately at the bottom of the periodic table to keep the table compact.

☛ Dmitri Mendeleev created the first periodic table, but he arranged elements based on their atomic weight.

☛ The modern periodic table includes 118 elements, out of which 94 occur naturally.

question:
When did Dmitri Mendeleev invent the periodic table, ordering the symbols of the chemical elements according to their atomic weights?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: 1794
1869
1890
1779
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1869

Explanation:
Dmitri Mendeleev invented the periodic table in 1869. He arranged the elements according to their atomic weights and also predicted that some elements, which were not yet discovered, would be found in the future. Mendeleev's periodic table demonstrated the periodicity of chemical and physical properties of elements. This table established a significant milestone in the field of chemistry and became the foundation of the modern periodic table.

Extra Facts:
Mendeleev's periodic table had 8 groups and 7 periods. He left gaps in his table, which were later filled by new elements like Gallium (Ga), Germanium (Ge), and Scandium (Sc). The modern periodic table arranges elements according to their atomic number, discovered by Henry Moseley. Elements in the periodic table are classified into metals, non-metals, and metalloids.

11 What is the atomic number of Nitrogen in the science periodic table?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: 21
7
18
11
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 7

Explanation:
The atomic number of Nitrogen (N) in the periodic table is 7. The atomic number represents the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom. Nitrogen is a non-metal located in Group 15 (or Group V) of the periodic table. It constitutes about 78% of the Earth's atmosphere and is essential for life as it is a key component of proteins and nucleic acids. The electronic configuration of Nitrogen is 2,5, indicating it has 5 electrons in its outermost shell.

Extra Facts:
Nitrogen gas (N2) exists as a diatomic molecule in the atmosphere. It is a colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas. Nitrogen is used in the production of fertilizers, explosives, and industrial chemicals. The nitrogen cycle describes the transformation of nitrogen in various forms in nature, which is crucial for ecosystems. Nitrogen-fixing bacteria, such as Rhizobium, live in the roots of plants and convert atmospheric nitrogen into compounds usable by plants.

[SSC MTS 2022]
options_hi: 21

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 7

Explanation:
आवर्त सारणी में नाइट्रोजन (N) की परमाणु संख्या 7 है। परमाणु संख्या किसी तत्व के नाभिक में उपस्थित प्रोटॉनों की संख्या को दर्शाती है। नाइट्रोजन एक अधातु है जो समूह 15 (पंचम समूह) में स्थित है। यह वायुमंडल का लगभग 78% हिस्सा बनाता है और जीवन के लिए अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह प्रोटीन और न्यूक्लिक अम्लों का एक प्रमुख घटक है। नाइट्रोजन का इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास 2,5 है, जो दर्शाता है कि इसके बाहरी कक्ष में 5 इलेक्ट्रॉन हैं।

Extra Facts:
नाइट्रोजन गैस (N2) वायुमंडल में द्विपरमाणुक अणु के रूप में पाई जाती है। यह रंगहीन, गंधहीन और स्वादहीन गैस है। नाइट्रोजन का उपयोग उर्वरकों, विस्फोटकों और औद्योगिक रसायनों के निर्माण में किया जाता है। नाइट्रोजन चक्र प्रकृति में नाइट्रोजन के विभिन्न रूपों के बीच परिवर्तन को दर्शाता है, जो पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के लिए आवश्यक है। नाइट्रोजन को स्थिर करने वाले जीवाणु, जैसे राइजोबियम, पौधों की जड़ों में रहते हैं और वायुमंडलीय नाइट्रोजन को पौधों द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले यौगिकों में परिवर्तित करते हैं।

question:
Select the correct order of the following metals in terms of their increasing reactivities.

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Au, Cu, Mg and K
K, Cu, Mg and Au
K, Mg, Cu and Au
Au, Mg, Cu and K
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Au, Cu, Mg and K

Explanation:
The reactivity of metals depends on their tendency to lose electrons. Metals that lose electrons more easily are more reactive. This order is known as the 'Metal Reactivity Series'. In this series, gold (Au) is the least reactive, followed by copper (Cu), magnesium (Mg), and potassium (K) is the most reactive. The correct order is:
Au < Cu < Mg < K

Extra Facts:
The Metal Reactivity Series is used in various chemical reactions, such as displacement reactions. For example, a more reactive metal can displace a less reactive metal from its salt solution. Highly reactive metals like potassium (K) and sodium (Na) react violently with water, while less reactive metals like gold (Au) and platinum (Pt) are found in nature in their free state.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams

☛ Which is the least reactive metal? → Gold (Au)
☛ Which metal reacts violently with water? → Sodium (Na)
☛ Where is magnesium located in the reactivity series? → After potassium and before copper
☛ Which metal is found in nature in its free state? → Gold (Au) and Platinum (Pt)

निम्नलिखित धातुओं की बढ़ती अभिक्रियाशीलता के आधार पर सही क्रम का चयन कीजिए।

[SSC MTS 2024]
options_hi: Au, Cu, Mg और K
K, Cu, Mg और Au
K, Mg, Cu और Au
Au, Mg, Cu और K
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है Au, Cu, Mg और K

Explanation:
धातुओं की अभिक्रियाशीलता का क्रम उनके इलेक्ट्रॉन त्यागने की प्रवृत्ति पर निर्भर करता है। धातुएँ जो आसानी से इलेक्ट्रॉन त्याग देती हैं, वे अधिक अभिक्रियाशील होती हैं। इस क्रम को 'धातु अभिक्रियाशीलता श्रेणी' (Metal Reactivity Series) के रूप में जाना जाता है। इसमें सबसे कम अभिक्रियाशील धातु सोना (Au) है, जिसके बाद तांबा (Cu), मैग्नीशियम (Mg) और सबसे अधिक अभिक्रियाशील धातु पोटैशियम (K) है। यह क्रम निम्नलिखित है:
Au < Cu < Mg < K

Extra Facts:
धातु अभिक्रियाशीलता श्रेणी का उपयोग विभिन्न रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं, जैसे विस्थापन अभिक्रिया (Displacement Reaction), में किया जाता है। उदाहरण के लिए, अधिक अभिक्रियाशील धातु कम अभिक्रियाशील धातु को उसके लवण विलयन से विस्थापित कर सकती है। पोटैशियम (K) और सोडियम (Na) जैसी धातुएँ इतनी अभिक्रियाशील होती हैं कि वे पानी के साथ हिंसक अभिक्रिया करती हैं, जबकि सोना (Au) और प्लैटिनम (Pt) जैसी धातुएँ प्रकृति में मुक्त अवस्था में पाई जाती हैं।

question:
Which German chemist was the first to show a graphical representation of the periodicity of an atomic volume plotted against atomic weight?

[SSC CPO 2023]
options: William Ramsay
John Newlands
Glenn T Seaborg
Lothar Meyer
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lothar Meyer

Explanation:
Lothar Meyer was a German chemist who, in 1869, graphically demonstrated the relationship between atomic volume and atomic weight. He observed that when atomic volume is plotted against atomic weight, the properties of elements show periodic repetition. This was a significant contribution to the development of the periodic table. Meyer's work showed that the physical properties of elements change periodically with their atomic weight, a discovery parallel to Dmitri Mendeleev's work.

Extra Facts:
Lothar Meyer's graph illustrated the relationship between atomic volume and atomic weight, highlighting that elemental properties depend on atomic weight. His work was a major step in the formulation of the periodic table. Both Meyer and Mendeleev independently discovered the periodic law, but Mendeleev gained more fame as he focused more on chemical properties and made predictions.

लोथर मेयर (Lothar Meyer)
solution_hi:

Explanation:
लोथर मेयर एक जर्मन रसायनज्ञ थे, जिन्होंने 1869 में परमाणु आयतन और परमाणु भार के बीच संबंध को ग्राफिक रूप से प्रदर्शित किया था। उन्होंने देखा कि जब परमाणु आयतन को परमाणु भार के विरुद्ध प्लॉट किया जाता है, तो तत्वों के गुणधर्म आवर्ती रूप से दोहराते हैं। यह आवर्त सारणी के विकास में एक महत्वपूर्ण योगदान था। मेयर ने अपने कार्य में दिखाया कि तत्वों के भौतिक गुण उनके परमाणु भार के साथ आवर्ती रूप से बदलते हैं, जो डिमित्री मेंडेलीफ के समानांतर खोज थी।

How many protons are there in a lithium nucleus?

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 3

Explanation:
Lithium (Li) is a chemical element with an atomic number of 3. The atomic number of an element represents the number of protons in its nucleus. Therefore, a lithium nucleus contains 3 protons. It is located in group 2 of the periodic table and is classified as an alkali metal. The most common isotope of lithium is lithium-7, which has 3 protons and 4 neutrons in its nucleus.

Extra Facts:
Lithium is the lightest metal and is used in lithium-ion batteries, psychiatric medications, and nuclear fusion reactions. It reacts vigorously with air and water, so it is stored in oil. Lithium was discovered in 1817 by Johan August Arfwedson. It has applications in ceramics, glass, and as a mood-stabilizing drug in medicine.

solution:

Explanation:
The metallic character increases down a group in the periodic table. This is because, as we move down, the atomic size increases, and the valence electrons are farther from the nucleus, making it easier to lose electrons. Thus, for alkali metals (Group 1), the order of metallic character is: Li (Lithium) < Na (Sodium) < K (Potassium) < Rb (Rubidium) < Cs (Caesium). This sequence corresponds to the increasing tendency to lose electrons, which is highest in Cs.

Extra Facts:
Alkali metals (Group 1) are highly reactive and are not found in pure form in nature. They react vigorously with water to produce hydrogen gas and alkaline solutions. Cs is the most reactive and explodes upon contact with air. These metals are used in photoelectric cells, nuclear reactors, and the glass industry.

question:
How many triads were mentioned in Dobereiner's Triads?

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Eight
Two
Six
Four
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Four

Explanation:
In Dobereiner's Triads, four triads were mentioned. German chemist Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner classified elements into triads based on their similar properties in 1817. He established a relationship between the atomic weights of elements and their chemical properties. Dobereiner's four major triads were: (1) Chlorine, Bromine, Iodine (2) Calcium, Strontium, Barium (3) Sulfur, Selenium, Tellurium (4) Lithium, Sodium, Potassium. In these triads, the atomic weight of the middle element was approximately the average of the other two elements, known as Dobereiner's Law of Triads.

Extra Facts:
Dobereiner's Triads played a significant role in the development of the modern periodic table. This classification demonstrated the relationship between the properties of elements and their atomic weights. However, the limitation of this method was that it could not include all known elements. Later, Newlands' Law of Octaves and Mendeleev's Periodic Table further developed this concept. Dobereiner's Triads laid the foundation for the classification of elements in chemistry.

Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba
Ba < Mg < Ca < Sr < Be
Mg < Be < Ca < Sr < Ba
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba

Explanation:
Alkaline earth metals are located in Group 2 of the periodic table. Their atomic numbers are as follows:
- Beryllium (Be) → 4
- Magnesium (Mg) → 12
- Calcium (Ca) → 20
- Strontium (Sr) → 38
- Barium (Ba) → 56

Thus, the correct sequence according to atomic number is: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba. This sequence reflects their position in the periodic table, where atomic number increases from left to right and top to bottom.

Extra Facts:
- Alkaline earth metals are highly reactive in nature and are not found in pure form.
- These metals react with water to produce hydrogen gas (e.g., Ca + 2H2O → Ca(OH)2 + H2).
- Their oxides and hydroxides are alkaline in nature, hence the name 'alkaline earth metals.'

solution:

solution_hi:

Explanation:
पृथ्वी की पर्पटी में पोटैशियम (K) सातवीं सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में पाई जाने वाली धातु है। इसका नाम मध्ययुगीन लैटिन शब्द 'केलियम (Kalium)' से लिया गया है, जिसके कारण इसका रासायनिक प्रतीक 'K' है। पोटैशियम एक क्षार धातु है जो समूह 1 (एल्कली मेटल्स) में आती है। यह अत्यधिक अभिक्रियाशील होती है और प्रकृति में शुद्ध रूप में नहीं पाई जाती, बल्कि यह विभिन्न यौगिकों (जैसे पोटैशियम क्लोराइड, पोटैशियम नाइट्रेट) के रूप में मिलती है। पोटैशियम पौधों और जानवरों के लिए एक आवश्यक पोषक तत्व है, जो कोशिकीय कार्यों और तंत्रिका आवेगों के संचरण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।

question:
Which of the following are metalloids?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: Boron, oxygen, aluminium
Boron, mercury, iron
Boron, silicon, antimony
Aluminium, mercury, copper
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Boron, Silicon, Antimony

Explanation:
Metalloids are elements that exhibit properties of both metals and non-metals. They are located between metals and non-metals in the periodic table. The major metalloids include Boron (B), Silicon (Si), Germanium (Ge), Arsenic (As), Antimony (Sb), and Tellurium (Te). Among the given options, Boron, Silicon, and Antimony are metalloids. Oxygen is a non-metal, while Aluminium, Mercury, Iron, and Copper are metals. Metalloids are particularly useful as semiconductors, especially in electronic devices.

Extra Facts:
Metalloids are crucial in science and technology due to their unique properties. Silicon (Si) is widely used in computer chips and solar cells. Boron (B) is used in the glass and ceramic industry. Antimony (Sb) is used in batteries and flame retardants. These elements are poor conductors of electricity, but their conductivity increases with temperature.

question:
Which of the following statements is correct?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Chlorine has the highest electron affinity, while fluorine has the highest electronegativity.
Fluorine has the highest electron affinity, while chlorine has the highest electronegativity.
Fluorine has the highest electron affinity and the highest electronegativity.
Fluorine has the highest electron affinity, while bromine has the highest electronegativity
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chlorine has the highest electron affinity, while fluorine has the highest electronegativity.

Explanation:
Electron affinity is the energy released when an atom gains an extra electron. Chlorine (Cl) has the highest electron affinity because its larger atomic size compared to fluorine (F) makes it easier to add an electron. On the other hand, electronegativity is the ability of an atom to attract electrons towards itself. Fluorine (F) has the highest electronegativity because it is the smallest and has the highest nuclear charge.

Extra Facts:
1. Electron affinity generally increases from left to right and decreases from top to bottom in the periodic table, but chlorine is an exception.
2. Electronegativity is highest for fluorine (F) with a value of 3.98 on the Pauling scale.
3. The electron affinity of chlorine (Cl) is 349 kJ/mol, while that of fluorine (F) is 328 kJ/mol.

question:
Which of the following elements has maximum density?

Lead
Osmium
solution:

Explanation:
Osmium is a transition metal belonging to the platinum group. It has the highest density (22.59 g/cm³) among all naturally occurring elements. Its high density is due to its atomic structure and hexagonal close-packed crystal lattice. Mercury is a liquid metal with a density of 13.534 g/cm³, Platinum has a density of 21.45 g/cm³, and Lead has a density of 11.34 g/cm³. Thus, among the given options, Osmium has the highest density.

Extra Facts:
Osmium is often used in high-hardness alloys, such as osmiridium, which is used in fountain pen tips, electrical contacts, and other high-durability devices. It is a very rare and expensive element. Osmium tetroxide (OsO₄) is a toxic compound used for staining biological samples. Additionally, Osmium is used in some special types of catalytic converters. It is also one of the least abundant elements in the Earth's crust.

ऑस्मियम (Osmium) एक संक्रमण धातु है जो प्लैटिनम समूह से संबंधित है। यह सभी प्राकृतिक रूप से पाए जाने वाले तत्वों में सबसे अधिक घनत्व (22.59 g/cm³) रखता है। इसका उच्च घनत्व इसके परमाणु संरचना और क्रिस्टल जालक (hexagonal close-packed structure) के कारण होता है। पारा (Mercury) एक तरल धातु है जिसका घनत्व 13.534 g/cm³ है, प्लेटिनम (Platinum) का घनत्व 21.45 g/cm³ है, और लेड (Lead) का घनत्व 11.34 g/cm³ है। इस प्रकार, दिए गए विकल्पों में ऑस्मियम का घनत्व सबसे अधिक है।

ऑस्मियम का उपयोग अक्सर उच्च कठोरता वाले मिश्र धातुओं में किया जाता है, जैसे कि ओसमिरिडियम (osmiridium), जिसका उपयोग फाउंटेन पेन के निब, विद्युत संपर्कों और अन्य उच्च-टिकाऊ उपकरणों में किया जाता है। यह बहुत ही दुर्लभ और महंगा तत्व है। ऑस्मियम टेट्रॉक्साइड (OsO₄) एक जहरीला यौगिक है जिसका उपयोग जैविक नमूनों को स्टेन करने में किया जाता है। इसके अलावा, ऑस्मियम का उपयोग कुछ विशेष प्रकार के कैटलिटिक कन्वर्टर्स में भी किया जाता है।

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1862

Explanation:
AEB de Chancourtois organized the elements by atomic weight in 1862 by graphing them around a cylinder with a circumference of 16 units, corresponding to the atomic weight of oxygen (O). He used a cylindrical chart called the Telluric Helix, where elements were arranged in a spiral, ensuring that elements with similar properties appeared vertically aligned. This was an early attempt to classify elements and a significant step toward the development of the Periodic Table, though it did not gain widespread recognition at the time.
